app_subtitle: The Ultimate Social Deduction Party Game
min_players_warning: Need at least 3 players to start
role_civilian_desc: You have the secret word. Give subtle clues and identify the impostor!
role_mr_white_desc: You have NO word! Listen carefully to others, blend in, and deduce the secret word!
role_undercover_desc: You have a slightly different word! Figure out who is civilian and don't get caught!
tap_and_hold: Tap and hold to reveal your secret role
no_word_warning: You have NO secret word. You are Mister White!
turn_of: It is {name}'s turn to give a clue
your_turn_clue: It's your turn! Say your clue out loud.
clue_give_instruction: Give 1 word or short clue related to your secret word.
discussion_desc: Debate who seems suspicious based on their clues.
tip_1: Who hesitated before giving their clue?
tip_2: Whose clue felt too generic or disconnected from the topic?
tip_3: If you are Mister White: pretend to be confident and point fingers subtly!
voting_desc: Select the player you believe is Mister White or Undercover.
tie_desc: Players {names} are tied. They have 30 seconds for a quick rebuttal before re-voting!
mr_white_guess_desc: You were caught! But you can still win if you can guess the civilians' secret word!
typing_guess_title: Mister White is typing their final guess...
typing_guess_desc: If they guess your secret word, they win!
guess_correct: CORRECT! Mister White stole the victory!
guess_wrong: INCORRECT! Mister White failed the guess.
pass_screen_tap: Tap when {name} is holding the phone
discuss_and_select_eliminated: Discuss in person, then select who you all vote to eliminate:
confirm_elimination_msg: Are you sure you want to eliminate {name}?
civilian_eliminated_sub: Mister White is still hiding among you! The game continues...
tie_vote_desc: No player was eliminated. Re-ordering speaking order to restart discussion!
reason_civilians_win: All impostors have been unmasked and eliminated!
reason_mr_white_guess_win: Mister White guessed the secret word correctly ("{word}") and stole the victory!
reason_mr_white_survived: Mister White survived and blended in until the end!
reason_undercover_survived: The Undercover agent survived and outsmarted the civilians!
reason_impostors_parity: The impostors reached numerical parity and won the game!
